text:
Nora P (SE): kicking off PrismBank POC thread. They require BYO HSM for envelope keys + per-request unwraps. New asks: rotation every <=6h, ephemeral KEKs for session isolation, and full key provenance (who/when key created). Also want cost model for high-frequency wrap/unwraps and an optional caching proxy.
Evan M (AE): pricing question 62; is proxy-level caching allowed or do we need to call HSM per request to satisfy audit? Customer wants predictable monthly cap.
Nora P (SE): caching is allowed if customer permits cached envelope keys; otherwise we can do per-op direct HSM calls. We'll propose two pricing lines: (A) strict HSM-only per-op, (B) HSM + short-lived proxy cache with reduced per-op rate.
Rashmi K (Security): SQ: they want attestation reports (vendor-signed), FIPS status, and demonstrable key provenance logs with signer identities. Also require that Redwood never holds unwrapped KEKs. Can we provide sample provenance events?
Luis B (SRE): attestation/provenance: yes we can provide vendor attestation + JSON provenance schema. Redwood only holds wrapped KEKs; unwrapping happens in customer HSM or in proxy with mTLS to their HSM. Latency note: direct HSM unwrap 6-30ms; proxy cache reduces median by ~10-15ms. We'll note circuit-breaker behavior: default fail-closed, optional fail-open for degraded perf.
Harper (Deal Ops): quote needs two variants: 1) BYO HSM with managed key-proxy (we operate proxy in customer VPC) and 2) private on-prem deployment. Add PS block for key-provenance runbook + 12h ceremony support (flat). Also include a one-time integration fee for high-QPS tuning.
Evan M (AE): acceptance criteria for POC: 1) end-to-end envelope encrypt/decrypt using their HSM, 2) rotation with zero dropped requests during switchover, 3) 95p end-to-end gen latency <=160ms, 4) provenance logs delivered to their SIEM. Can we stream to their HTTP/S Splunk endpoint?
Nora P (SE): yes 62; we'll stream key-op and provenance events as structured JSON via HTTPS. Sample event schema will be included in the runbook.
Rashmi K (Security): they pressed on indemnity: customer wants a clause that Redwood won't assume liability for customer-controlled keys. Legal will push standard BYOK language; flag for sales.
Luis B (SRE): quick config example for docs:
```
# bind with proxy-cache enabled (ttl=60s)
redwoodctl kms bind --mode byo \
  --key-arn arn:hsm:us-west-2:acct:key/px-007 \
  --proxy https://proxy.prism.internal --mtls-cert /etc/prism.pem \
  --cache-ttl 60
```
Evan M (AE): please capture PS hours and per-op bands. Also add optional SLA for key-op latency and extended log retention (default 90d, can purchase 365d).
redwood-upload-bot: uploaded artifact: prism-poc/attestation_and_provenance_sample.zip
Harper (Deal Ops): thanks all 62; I'll produce two-variant quote + SOW with PS lines and circulate to legal/finance within 24h. Closing for now. :white_check_mark:
